name: smwpatches-level-specific-speeds-for-monty-moles-and-hammers
title: Level Specific Speeds for Monty Moles and Hammers
description:
Normally, Monty Moles wait more time before jumping out if the level is in the Yoshi's Island submap, while Hammer Brothers throw hammers more quickly if the level is in any submap. With this patch, you can decide for every "overworld level" (see $13BF) whether Monty Moles should jump out quickly or slowly, and whether Hammer Brothers should throw hammers quickly or slowly.
You can also change the speed values themselves directly in the ASM file if you wish to do so.

update: fixed bug with the Amazing Flyin' Hammer Bro only throwing hammers in one direction, thanks to medic.
